summary:
Verified all 16 requested occurrences using opened primary sources: 14 CONFIRMED and 2 UNVERIFIABLE. The ledger was empty. R0010-C014 and R0010-C016 require documentation clarification because their specific referenced downloads or documented behavior are absent from the permitted inputs. Reviewed newer developments from 2025-04-09 through 2026-10-09.

Landscape scan, 2026-08-10 through 2026-10-09; all sources accessed 2026-10-09:
1. [CamWorldQA](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.18710v1), published 2026-08-19: evaluates camera-controlled generated video using 720 videos and an 18-person subjective study with randomized presentation and explicit perceptual criteria. Relevant to generative-video evaluation and human evaluation protocols; does not change this step's sealing or storage contracts.
2. [BeyondMasks](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.20107v1), published 2026-08-20: evaluates object removal against its intended effects, including removal of shadows and reflections. Relevant to intent-conditioned evaluation; its task-specific judge results do not establish general evaluator validity or require an L04 change.
3. [Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34320v1), published 2026-09-28: examines correlated evaluation samples and task-level calibration. Relevant to judge reliability and selective evaluation; the proposed bootstrap certificate is explicitly approximate, without a finite-sample theorem. Findings concern agent trajectories and do not validate media judging or change this step.
4. [EPUB Annotations 1.0](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-epub-anno-10-20260920/), published 2026-09-20: a W3C Working Draft profiles annotation identities, creators, timestamps, targets and selectors. Relevant as annotation-interchange context, with low direct relevance to L04; it is neither a finalized standard nor evidence of complete media provenance. No adoption proposed.
